maddeler.e:
اقترحوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَحُوا (iqtaraḥū) /iq.ta.ra.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# اُقْتُرِحُوا (uqturiḥū) /uq.tu.ri.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# اِقْتَرِحُوا (iqtariḥū) /iq.ta.ri.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
